Initiates a Payment. It starts in `pending` status and settles
asynchronously. Always send an `Idempotency-Key`: without it, a network
timeout leaves you unable to tell whether the Payment was created, and a
blind retry can pay the beneficiary twice.

`payer_name` and `payer_account` are derived from the debited Account and
must not be sent. `fee_amount` is quoted by the Custodian once the Payment
is accepted, so it is null until the Payment reaches `processing`.
